summary: Over two episodes (about 2.2 minutes of play, 68 decisions) the agent collected all 5 coins twice, taking them in four ways: walking straight in, jumping into one, running and jumping over one, and walking past one's edge. It also went back to the spots of coins already taken and jumped there. The counter was right every time. Each of the 10 pickups raised leaderstats Coins by exactly that coin's Value (Coin3 +2, the others +1), to 6 in total. No coin counted twice, and an empty spot never gave a coin. The door opened at Coins 5. The problems: the HUD never shows coin progress, and the door opens while a coin is still left, so the last coin does nothing.
evidence: trace1.jsonl events: Coins 0->1 (Coin1, t=10.8), 1->3 (Coin3 Value 2, t=23.3), 3->4 (Coin4, t=27.7), then 5 and 6, with no gain different from the coin's Value ('mismatches': 0)
trace2.jsonl events: 0->1 Coin1 walked in (t=2.8), 1->3 Coin3 jumped into (t=8.5), 3->4 Coin2 run-and-jump-over (t=15.5), then 5 (door_open true at t~65) and 6 at t=68.2, with 0 mismatches
revisit_taken_coin_spot x6 over both episodes: 'Coins 1 -> 1', 'Coins 5 -> 5', 'Coins 4 -> 4 at an empty spot': a coin taken once never pays again
brush_past_coin_edge (ep2 t=17.5): passing 85 cm to the side of the coin left it in place with Coins unchanged
hud_status 'Collect the coins' at every 5 s sample in both episodes, including Coins 6 with the door open (ep1 t=61, ep2 t=68.2)
Game log, each episode: [Error] Workspace.Sign.SignText:3: attempt to index nil with 'TextLabel'; [Warning] x2 ContentId rbxassetid://203785492 Asset type does not match requested type
findings: The HUD gives no coin feedback. Hud.Status reads 'Collect the coins' at 0, 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 Coins, and still reads it after the door opens. TestPlaceClient only changes it for the win and the shop. Players only see their count in the leaderboard and get no hint that the door opened.

The door opens at 5 Coins (CoinGame NEEDED=5), but the coins add up to 6 because Coin3 is worth 2. Taking Coin3 opens the door with one coin still out (ep2: door_open at Coins 5 with coins_left 1). The last coin then does nothing. NEEDED should be 6, or the values or the text should change.

Coins aren't reset or kept per player: CoinGame's 'taken' flag and coin:Destroy() are global. In a server with more than one player, whoever touches a coin first takes it from everyone, and the coins never respawn. Read from the code; this run had only one player.
Unrelated error on every start: Workspace.Sign.SignText:3 'attempt to index nil with TextLabel' (the Sign has no SurfaceGui), plus 2 warnings for asset rbxassetid://203785492 being the wrong type.
